answers.justification: For cohort A PFS at 29 March 2019 (207 vs 99 randomized), 119 events (66/207; 53/99) and approximately 16-month median follow-up are reported, but event counts are not observed-outcome counts. Flow figure reports two placebo losses and ITT membership, not endpoint ascertainment. Treatment discontinuation is not itself missing outcome data.
unknowns: Arm-specific PFS observation/censoring status and follow-up after treatment cessation.

bases.unresolved_premise: Whether PFS data were available for all or nearly all randomized cohort A participants at cutoff.
bases.stopping_rationale: Inspected article and full supplement; no endpoint-observed counts. Registry projection read failed integrity verification; no replacement/network retrieval attempted.
